segments: Hey, let me tell you something you
probably didn't know. Did you know
France just banned IUIC for teaching the
Bible? Let me show you. Pascal Leg, an
advisor to the government, just petition
to ban IUIC from teaching the Bible to
blacks and Hispanics in France. So what
this woman did was labeled IUIC,
slandered us, saying that we're a hate
group, saying that we abuse children,
saying that we're a black identity
extremist group. But all we do is to
teach the Bible. When it comes to the
fringe decree, they banned us from
saying shalom. Shalom means peace. We
can't even say peace to each other. They
even banned us from wearing our fringes.
They banned us from keeping the Sabbath
day. We can't even gather together. Who
would have thought that reading and
teaching the Bible would have got us so
much hate? In Matthew 24:9, Christ let
us know that we was going to be hated by
all nations for his name's sake. And
when we see these things come to pass,
it fills our faith. The Bible is a true
book.
